title: ARC owner authorization token
description: claims/<TASK-ID>/authorized.json (legacy stream) or arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/<TASK-ID>/authorized.json (ARC namespace, B4 / P-E) - the owner's execution grant. Written ONLY by /arc-authorize. Its presence is the authorization; claim.state AUTHORIZED without a valid file here fails closed to BLOCKED and is never repaired by a worker.

taskId.description: Must equal the containing directory name and the claim's taskId.

planId.description: Plan identity is carried so an authorization cannot silently survive a plan change (contract section 6.3).

authorizedBy.description: Owner identity. Provenance for review, NOT an unforgeable credential - see the R-1 note below.

note.description: Optional owner text recording the scope or condition of the grant.

ownerToken.description: RESERVED, UNUSED IN V1. Contract R-1 records that nothing in the filesystem prevents a worker writing this file; allowed-tools is not runtime-enforced (execution-plan conflict X-9). The available mitigation is an owner-supplied value a worker cannot derive. It is deliberately not built in V1, and this field exists so adding it later requires no schema change.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). Required in arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/<TASK-ID>/ records and must equal the directory <ARC-ID>; must be absent in claims/<TASK-ID>/ records. Shape only: the namespace rule is scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js authorizedMatchesPath, applied by every reader.

OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). ARC identity. Absent in every legacy record; present in every ARC-scoped record and equal to the ARC it belongs to - the publisher's ARC literal for a snapshot, its manifest and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json (three-way equality), the arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ directory for claims, tokens and the holders taken for that ARC. Never inferred from a task-id prefix, a filename or a slug. The reserved Windows device-name guard applies uniformly (N-3). The schema validates shape only; namespace rules live in scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js.
